name: fist-arm-alignment-qc
description: QC HeroGauntletV2 scale, complete hand anatomy, current-rig R15/R6 wrist alignment, visible avatar hand, sanitized non-interactive geometry, and one real equip request per tested tier; screenshots are captured directly through Studio MCP after regression.

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation
local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1]
c:Invoke('Reset')
c:Invoke('SetStats',{Coins=1000000,Power=1000,Depth=75,WallLevel=99})
local names={'Boxing Glove','Iron Knuckle','Thunder Fist','Titan Gauntlet'}
local purchases={}
for _,name in ipairs(names) do
 local result=c:Invoke('BuyFist',name)
 purchases[name]=result.ok==true
 assert(result.ok==true,'failed to prepare fist '..name..': '..H:JSONEncode(result))
end
p:SetAttribute('LastMobileAction',0)
local owned=H:JSONDecode(p.RPGStats.OwnedFistsJSON.Value)
local allOwned=true
for _,name in ipairs(names) do allOwned=allOwned and table.find(owned,name)~=nil end
local result={valid=allOwned and p.RPGStats.EquippedFist.Value=='Titan Gauntlet',allOwned=allOwned,equipped=p.RPGStats.EquippedFist.Value,purchases=purchases,owned=owned}
assert(result.valid,'fist alignment catalog seed failed: '..H:JSONEncode(result))
return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: prepare four owned alignment tiers authoritatively

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local actionRemote=RS.PunchWallEvents.ActionRequest
local specs={
 {name='Boxing Glove',tier=2,style='Boxing',pattern='BoxingWrap'},
 {name='Iron Knuckle',tier=3,style='Iron',pattern='RivetedIron'},
 {name='Thunder Fist',tier=4,style='Thunder',pattern='ThunderRails'},
 {name='Titan Gauntlet',tier=5,style='Titan',pattern='SiegePlates'},
}
local required={'Hero Gauntlet Palm Shell','Hero Gauntlet Wrist Cuff','Hero Gauntlet Wrist Bridge','Hero Gauntlet Backhand Plate','Hero Closed Knuckle 1','Hero Closed Knuckle 2','Hero Closed Knuckle 3','Hero Closed Knuckle 4','Hero Folded Thumb','Hero Gauntlet Energy Core'}
local function verify(spec)
 local deadline=os.clock()+4
 local character,hand,root,gauntlet
 repeat
  character=p.Character
  hand=character and (character:FindFirstChild('RightHand') or character:FindFirstChild('Right Arm'))
  root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
  gauntlet=character and character:FindFirstChild('Equipped Kaiju Gauntlet')
  if p.RPGStats.EquippedFist.Value==spec.name and gauntlet and gauntlet:GetAttribute('Tier')==spec.tier and gauntlet:GetAttribute('FistStyle')==spec.style then break end
  task.wait(.05)
 until os.clock()>=deadline
 local parts,welds,anchored,collidable,behaviorUnsafe,maxDistance=0,0,0,0,0,0
 local missing={}
 if gauntlet then
  for _,descendant in ipairs(gauntlet:GetDescendants()) do
   if descendant:IsA('BasePart') then
    parts+=1
    if descendant.Anchored then anchored+=1 end
    if descendant.CanCollide or descendant.CanTouch or descendant.CanQuery then collidable+=1 end
    if hand then maxDistance=math.max(maxDistance,(descendant.Position-hand.Position).Magnitude) end
   elseif descendant:IsA('WeldConstraint') then
    welds+=1
   elseif descendant:IsA('LuaSourceContainer') or descendant:IsA('Tool') or descendant:IsA('RemoteEvent') or descendant:IsA('RemoteFunction') or descendant:IsA('BindableEvent') or descendant:IsA('BindableFunction') or descendant:IsA('ClickDetector') or descendant:IsA('ProximityPrompt') or descendant:IsA('Sound') or descendant:IsA('AnimationController') or descendant:IsA('Animator') or descendant:IsA('Humanoid') or descendant:IsA('BodyMover') or descendant:IsA('JointInstance') or descendant:IsA('Constraint') then
    behaviorUnsafe+=1
   end
  end
  for _,name in ipairs(required) do if not gauntlet:FindFirstChild(name,true) then table.insert(missing,name) end end
 else
  for _,name in ipairs(required) do table.insert(missing,name) end
 end
 local boundsCFrame,boundsSize
 if gauntlet then boundsCFrame,boundsSize=gauntlet:GetBoundingBox() end
 local localCenter=hand and boundsCFrame and hand.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(boundsCFrame.Position) or Vector3.new(99,99,99)
 local forward=root and hand and boundsCFrame and (boundsCFrame.Position-hand.Position):Dot(root.CFrame.LookVector) or -99
 local alignment=gauntlet and gauntlet:GetAttribute('AlignmentStandard') or ''
 local expectedAlignment=hand and (hand.Name=='RightHand' and 'R15RightHand' or hand.Name=='Right Arm' and 'R6DistalWrist' or '') or ''
 local ratio=tonumber(gauntlet and gauntlet:GetAttribute('VisualToHandRatio')) or 99
 local aura=gauntlet and gauntlet:GetAttribute('TierAura') or ''
 local auraRate=tonumber(gauntlet and gauntlet:GetAttribute('AuraRate')) or 0
 local complete=#missing==0
 local handVisible=hand~=nil and hand.Transparency<1
 local valid=character~=nil and hand~=nil and root~=nil and p.RPGStats.EquippedFist.Value==spec.name and gauntlet~=nil and gauntlet:GetAttribute('VisualSystem')=='HeroGauntletV2' and gauntlet:GetAttribute('VisualSource')=='ProceduralRuntime' and gauntlet:GetAttribute('ImportedRuntimeSilhouette')==false and gauntlet:GetAttribute('SilhouetteFamily')=='HeroGauntletV2' and gauntlet:GetAttribute('Tier')==spec.tier and gauntlet:GetAttribute('FistStyle')==spec.style and gauntlet:GetAttribute('ArmorPattern')==spec.pattern and gauntlet:GetAttribute('ShopArtMatchedTier')==spec.tier and alignment==expectedAlignment and expectedAlignment~='' and gauntlet:GetAttribute('KnuckleCount')==4 and gauntlet:GetAttribute('HasWristCuff')==true and gauntlet:GetAttribute('HasBackhandPlate')==true and gauntlet:GetAttribute('HasFoldedThumb')==true and gauntlet:GetAttribute('HasEnergyCore')==true and gauntlet:GetAttribute('WristAttachmentBounded')==true and gauntlet:GetAttribute('FaceOcclusionSafe')==true and gauntlet:GetAttribute('WithinVisualPartBudget')==true and gauntlet:GetAttribute('WholeHandHidden')==false and gauntlet:GetAttribute('HandTransparencyPreserved')==true and handVisible and complete and parts>=10 and parts<=28 and welds>=parts and anchored==0 and collidable==0 and behaviorUnsafe==0 and maxDistance<3.6 and ratio>=1.1 and ratio<=2.2 and math.abs(localCenter.X)<.4 and forward>.02 and aura~='' and auraRate>0
 local result={valid=valid,name=spec.name,tier=gauntlet and gauntlet:GetAttribute('Tier') or 0,style=gauntlet and gauntlet:GetAttribute('FistStyle') or '',pattern=gauntlet and gauntlet:GetAttribute('ArmorPattern') or '',rig=hand and hand.Name or '',alignment=alignment,expectedAlignment=expectedAlignment,handVisible=handVisible,handTransparency=hand and hand.Transparency or -1,parts=parts,welds=welds,anchored=anchored,collidable=collidable,unsafe=behaviorUnsafe,maxDistance=maxDistance,ratio=ratio,localX=localCenter.X,forward=forward,aura=aura,auraRate=auraRate,complete=complete,missing=missing,bounds=boundsSize and {x=boundsSize.X,y=boundsSize.Y,z=boundsSize.Z} or {}}
 assert(valid,'HeroGauntlet alignment contract failed: '..H:JSONEncode(result))
 return result
end
local results={}
for index,spec in ipairs(specs) do
 actionRemote:FireServer({action='EquipFist',target=spec.name})
 results[index]=verify(spec)
 if index<#specs then task.wait(.16) end
end
local result={valid=#results==#specs,count=#results,results=results}
assert(result.valid,'alignment matrix incomplete: '..H:JSONEncode(result))
return H:JSONEncode(result)
